description: This PHP source file defines the class 'GroupedTabStructure', which manages the structure of tabs within the SuiteCRM interface. It includes a method to generate the tab structure based on a list of modules, applying patches, handling iframe modules, and customizable key naming. The file contains licensing info, class definition, and a main method that builds the tab hierarchy.

classes.name: GroupedTabStructure
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and generating the structure of tabs in the SuiteCRM UI.

methods.name: get_tab_structure
methods.description: Generates and returns the complete structure of tabs for the SuiteCRM interface, considering module list, patches, iframe inclusion, and labeling options.
